result:
I've repaired all three findings (F-DG6-222, F-DG6-221, F-DG6-261), and every required check passed. The changes are left uncommitted on `dg6/fe-z2`. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-FE-Z2-frontend-ux-engineer.md`, with logs and screenshots in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-FE-Z2-evidence/`.

One a02 run failed, and I caused it. My first 5-run attempt had 1 failure out of 10. That run had passed all twelve steps, but its trace files disappeared at the end. I had started a probe at the same time that used the same Playwright `test-results/` folder, and Playwright clears that folder when a run starts. I reran the full 5×2 on its own with a separate output folder: 10 of 10 passed. Both logs are in the evidence (`40a-…` and `40b-…`).

**What changed**
- **F-DG6-222 (Medium):** when IT has not bound a secret, the form now marks the field the server error names and explains why in English or Arabic. On the connector form that is the credential row; on the other secret-reference forms it is the matching field (webhook create/rotate, SMTP, storage save/test, assistant). The banner's "check the highlighted fields" is now true. An error with no matching field on screen is shown inside the form's one alert instead. The three secret-reference error codes now have English and Arabic texts. The Arabic is new, labelled provisional and awaits a Mobily language review.
- **F-DG6-221 (Low):** "Last error" on the operations exception page now shows the catalogue text for the error code, the same text the Connectors page uses. With no catalogue text it shows the code itself, never the server's English sentence. The Arabic screen now reads "آخر خطأ: لم يستجب نظام المصدر.".
- **F-DG6-261 (Low):** step 10 of the a02 spec now selects from the Generate form only and waits for the "charter" option before selecting; no assertion was removed. The label was also ambiguous for screen-reader users, so I renamed the snapshot-list filter to "Filter by output" / "التصفية حسب المخرَج". I replayed QA's reproduction with the report definitions held back 0, 4 and 8 s, in both languages: "charter" always reached the right select.

**Checks**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG5` | PASS, exit 0 (run before any change) |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier check, `pnpm openapi:lint` | all exit 0 on the final tree |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | exit 0: 2899 / 2039 / 259 passed (2 skipped) |
| `pnpm test`, `C.UTF-8` | exit 0: same counts |
| New spec `p6-secret-ref-unbound.spec.ts`, en + ar | 4 passed |
| 8 touched specs, en + ar (new spec, connector, admin screens, reports ×2, a17, a15, a07) | 54 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky |
| a02 demo walkthrough, 5 runs per language, isolated | 10 passed, 0 failed |

I added web unit tests in both languages for every changed form and for the operations page, plus the a17 last-error check. The new e2e spec has a 90 s budget per test; its slowest measured run took 4.3 s.

I added no operations, no API, schema or OpenAPI changes, no migration and no dependency. The handback also covers:
- a suggestion for whoever owns `problems-all.test.ts`: it missed these error codes because the API emits them through constants;
- one issue I noticed but did not change: the connector edit screen shows "Choose…" for the target transformation when the admin can't see it in the list. The stored value is kept and saving still works.

No business, Finance or IT approval was granted, and all data is synthetic.
